driver.carrierPlace.or: No address? Pin your station instead.
driver.carrierPlace.stationPh: The stage, yard or place you work from
driver.carrierPlace.mapLabel: Map to pin the station you work from
driver.carrierPlace.found: Pinned near {where}. Move the pin to the exact spot if you need to.
driver.carrierPlace.notFound: That place could not be found. Tap the map where your station is.
driver.carrierPlace.idle: Type its name and find it, or tap the map.
driver.carrierPlace.set: On your notes as the carrier: {where}.
driver.idPhoto.body: You ride already. Until SeeBuyGet has seen your ID, you carry at most {cap, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} at once. Photograph your ID card in good light, every corner in the picture.
driver.idPhoto.label: Your ID card
driver.idPhoto.sentToast: Your ID photo is with SeeBuyGet
driver.idPhoto.sentDetail: You are told when it has been seen. Ride on as you are until then.
driver.idPhoto.waitingTitle: Your ID photo is with SeeBuyGet
driver.idPhoto.waiting: Sent {day}. You are told when it has been seen; from then, what you may carry grows with each parcel you hand on.
driver.idPhoto.refusedTitle: Your last photo was not accepted
driver.toast.heldDetail: The shipper and your fleet’s office are told too. Tap “Let go” when you drive on.
driver.toast.heldQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.heldQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, dated now. Tap “Let go” when you drive on.
driver.toast.letGoDetail: Operations, the shipper and your office are told.
driver.toast.letGoQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.letGoQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, dated now.
driver.bag.notClosed: Not closed yet: the shop or hub closes it — a coded seal or a photograph — before you take it.
driver.bag.notRead: Seal not read yet: it is received nowhere until you read it
driver.bag.readBody: It was loaded onto you by your pass. Read its seal and photograph it now: it is received nowhere until you have.
driver.bag.report: Something is not right with this bag
driver.loose.title: {count, plural, one {# parcel handed to you} other {# parcels handed to you}}
driver.loose.closedDetail: It cannot be handed in there. Find another shop near it: its buyer chooses from the ones you pick.
driver.shopClosed.title: {shop} is closed
driver.shopClosed.detail: Its parcels cannot be handed in there. Find another shop near it: their buyers choose from the ones you pick, and the bag goes to the one most chose.
driver.shopClosed.findLede: Pick up to three you can take the bag to. Their buyers choose from your pick until you get there; where nobody chose, your first pick takes it.
driver.shopClosed.shutLede: Found it shut? Pick up to three shops near it you can take the bag to. The shop and operations are told it was shut, and its buyers choose from your pick.
driver.shopClosed.none: No shop near it has room for the whole bag now. Keep it with you, and call operations.
driver.shopClosed.askedDetail: Take the bag to the shop most of them choose — it says so on the bag. Nobody chose by then: your first pick.
driver.shopClosed.status: {answered} of {asked, plural, one {# buyer} other {# buyers}} answered · take it to {shop}
driver.toast.bagRead: Seal read — bag {ref} is yours to hand over
driver.toast.bagReadDetail: Whoever receives it reads the seal again before opening it.
driver.toast.bagReadQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.bagReadQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, with its photograph. The bag is received once it has.
driver.toast.bagHeldDetail: SeeBuyGet operations is told. Keep it closed and where it is until operations releases it.
driver.toast.bagHeldQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, with its photograph. Keep the bag closed, and hand it to nobody meanwhile.
driver.toast.tamperReportedDetail: SeeBuyGet operations and the shipper are told. Keep the load closed and where it is until operations releases it.
driver.toast.tamperQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.tamperQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, with its photograph. Do not take the load over or hand it over meanwhile.
driver.toast.sealQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.sealQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, with its photographs, dated now.
driver.toast.passageQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.passageQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, dated now. Say the next step when it comes.
driver.toast.photoHeld: No signal: the photo waits on this phone
driver.toast.photoHeldDetail: It goes with your report when there is a signal.
driver.toast.breakdownArrivedDetail: It is dated when you reported it.
driver.brk.queuedTitle: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.brk.queuedDetail: It goes to your office the moment there is a signal, dated now, with where you are. If you can, phone your office as well.
driver.toast.roadRefutedDetail: It keeps warning until an operator checks it.
driver.fleet.title: Your fleet
driver.fleet.daysNone: {company} has not said who drives on any coming day.
driver.fleet.daysHint: Your fleet’s office says who drives each day, to plan its vehicles. You can still start a shift on any day.
driver.fleet.nowNone: You are not in a fleet now.
driver.fleet.removed: {company} took you off their fleet on {day}.
driver.fleet.leaveDetail: You stop driving for {company} now, and their office is told. You need nobody’s permission. Your licence, your trips and your rating stay yours. You cannot start a shift again until a fleet offers you a place. If you are on one of their runs that has not left yet, you come off it.
driver.fleet.leftDetailRun: Their office has been told, and that the {run} run needs another driver.
driver.fleet.leftDetailRuns: Their office has been told, and that {count} of their runs need another driver.
driver.fleet.removedLeft: They say you no longer work for them.
driver.fleet.removedEnded: They say they ended your contract.
driver.fleet.removedNext: Your trips, papers and rating stay yours. You cannot start a shift until a fleet offers you a place.
driver.fleet.removedNextAlone: Your trips, papers and rating stay yours. You cannot start a shift until a fleet offers you a place, or you choose to ride for yourself: “Your fleet”, under your name.
driver.fleet.leaveDetailLight: You stop driving for {company} now, and their office is told. You need nobody’s permission. Your licence, your trips and your rating stay yours. You cannot start a shift again until a fleet offers you a place, or you choose to ride for yourself, which on a bicycle you can do at once from this screen. If you are on one of their runs that has not left yet, you come off it.
driver.alone.title: Ride for yourself
driver.alone.lede: On a bicycle you can ride for yourself from now, with no fleet. The network then works with you directly and pays you for what you carry. Your licence, your trips and your rating stay as they are.
driver.alone.companyDetail: That is the company the network trades as where you live, and it is who pays you. Afterwards its licences are in Settings, under “Who you contract with”.
driver.alone.noCompany: No company of ours stands in {country}
driver.alone.noCompanyDetail: You can still ride there. Whoever you carry for pays you directly, and the network holds no money for you.
driver.alone.plateBike: A bicycle has no plate: type what is painted or marked on yours, so it can be told from another.
driver.alone.needCountry: Choose the country you live in.
driver.alone.doneDetail: Your vehicle is on your start screen. Start a shift when you are ready.
driver.alone.doneDetailCompany: You ride for {company}. Your vehicle is on your start screen: start a shift when you are ready.
driver.alone.ledeCheck: You can ride for yourself, with no fleet. On a motorcycle, a van, a truck or anything larger the network first reads your ID and your licence and checks your record, as for anybody signing up on one. You are told here when it decides; until then nothing changes.
driver.alone.checkTitle: Network staff read these before you ride
driver.alone.checkDetail: A clear photograph of each, with all four corners in view. Only network staff see them, and they are deleted once staff have decided.
driver.alone.needPapers: Add a photograph of your ID card and one of your licence.
driver.alone.waitingTitle: The network is checking your papers
driver.alone.waiting: On {day} you asked to ride for yourself on your {vehicle} ({plate}). You are told here when it is decided.
driver.alone.refusedTitle: Your last ask was not approved
driver.alone.askedDetail: Staff read your ID and your licence. You are told here when they decide.
driver.fleet.howTitle: How a fleet takes you on
driver.fleet.how: Give the fleet office the phone number you sign in with. They offer you a place, and it shows here for you to say yes or no. Nobody can say yes for you, and no code is typed anywhere.
driver.fleet.offerUntil: Open until {day}. Nothing changes unless you say yes.
driver.fleet.blockedTitle: Finish this before you say yes to {company}
driver.fleet.keeps: Your licence, your trips and your rating come with you.
driver.fleet.confirmFrom: {from} is told you have left. Every trip you did for them stays in their records.
driver.fleet.confirmCourier: From now on the network pays {company} for your work rather than you, and your public page closes — the fleet is the one the network works with.
driver.fleet.signedInAgain: You are signed in again on this phone as their driver; any other phone signs in again too.
driver.fleet.doneDetail: Their office can see you under Drivers.
driver.fleet.declinedToast: You said no. The fleet has been told.
driver.home.offerTitle: {company} offers you a place in their fleet
driver.home.offersTitle: {count, plural, one {# fleet has} other {# fleets have}} offered you a place
driver.home.offerDetail: Say yes or no. The first offer is open until {day}, and nothing changes unless you say yes.
driver.home.betweenTitle: You are not in a fleet now
driver.home.pinWhy: A shift records who is driving. Your PIN shows it is you, even on a phone that was left signed in.
driver.check.title: Daily check · {plate}
driver.check.loading: Reading what this vehicle is checked for…
driver.check.why: Walk round the vehicle and say what you find. A problem goes to your office at once.
driver.check.whyRequired: Your fleet asks for this check before a shift. Walk round the vehicle and say what you find.
driver.check.checkedToday: {who} checked it already today. Check it again if you are taking it out.
driver.check.safetyItem: A problem here keeps it off the road
driver.check.sayWhat: For each problem, say what is wrong or add a photo.
driver.check.problemsUsable: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} reported — it can still go out.
driver.check.notSafe: Not safe to drive: it stays off the road until your office has it fixed.
driver.defect.open: Report a problem with the vehicle
driver.defect.title: A problem with the vehicle
driver.defect.safeQ: Is it safe to keep driving?
driver.defect.stop: Stop where it is safe, and call your office.
driver.defect.stopDetail: The vehicle goes off the road: no shift starts in it until the office has it fixed.
driver.brk.title: Broken down
driver.brk.notePh: e.g. steam from the bonnet, it will not start
driver.brk.whereFound: Where you are goes with it, so the office can find you.
driver.brk.whereNone: Your phone could not say where you are: the office gets the last place it knew.
driver.brk.safety: If anybody is hurt, or the vehicle is in the road, call for help first.
driver.brk.toldDetail: Stay with the vehicle if it is safe to. You are told what the office decides. Your shift is yours to end.
driver.brk.keepShift: Keep your shift going until the loads are handed over: the driver who comes for them needs the six digits under “Show my badge”.
driver.tko.open: Take over the loads of a broken-down vehicle
driver.tko.title: Take over the loads
driver.tko.what: {plate} broke down. Everything it still carries comes to you:
driver.tko.passHint: Ask them to open “Show my badge” and read you the six digits under it, or scan their badge.
driver.tko.doneDetail: {list}: yours to deliver, or to collect, from now. {from}’s office has been told.
driver.brk.toldDetailCourier: Stay with your vehicle if it is safe to. Say how it ends under its upkeep. Your shift is yours to end.
driver.brk.couriersToldOne: A courier near you was told, and can come and take your bags and parcels on.
driver.brk.couriersToldMany: {n} couriers near you were told: one of them can come and take your bags and parcels on.
driver.brk.couriersNone: No courier near you could be told just now. Your bags and parcels stay with you, and their receivers are told if they run late. A courier who comes near can still take them on.
driver.brk.keepShiftCourier: Keep your shift going until they are taken on: the courier who comes needs the six digits under “Show my badge”. The road you drove with each bag is paid to you then.
driver.tko.openCourier: Take over a broken-down courier’s bags
driver.tko.whatNear: {who} broke down {km} km from you. Their bags and parcels come to you:
driver.tko.payRoad: The road that is left on each bag is yours, paid when you hand it in. The road already driven is paid to the one it was taken from.
driver.brk.shippersTold: {n, plural, one {The shipper of the load aboard has been told.} other {The shippers of the # loads aboard have been told.}}
driver.home.odoHint: Optional. It is how your office knows when the vehicle is due a service.
driver.home.odoEndHint: Optional. The shift ends whatever you type here.
driver.home.pinLocked: Sign out from the menu, then tap “Forgot your PIN?”. A code sent to your phone lets you choose a new PIN.
driver.signin.signedOutNote: This happens when your driver account signs in on another phone, your PIN changes, or you change fleet. If that was not you, tap “Forgot your PIN?” and choose a new PIN. That signs the other phone out.
driver.loads.invoiceMissingShort: Not yet: the shipper has not signed its commercial invoice
driver.loads.sealMissingShort: Not yet: a seal is required and none is written
driver.loads.sealMissingDetail: {why}. You cannot take the goods over until it is written: ask the shipper.
driver.loads.invoiceMissingTitle: The commercial invoice is not signed
driver.loads.invoiceMissingDetail: These goods cross a border, and the shipper has not signed its invoice or said its own travels with them. You cannot take them over until it does: ask the shipper.
driver.manifest.missingTitle: The border manifest is not complete
driver.manifest.title: Border manifest — Moyale
driver.toast.freightDeliveredHeld: Your capacity is freed. Your pay for it is released in 24 hours, unless the sender reports a problem before then.
driver.hold.title: Problems reported
driver.hold.lede: The sender reported a problem with a load you delivered, so your pay for it is held. Answer once: SeeBuyGet reads your answer beside the report and applies the protocol.
driver.hold.how: When something goes wrong: how it is decided
driver.hold.answerLede: Say what you saw when you took it over and at the door. Add a photo if you have one. You answer once.
driver.hold.answeredToastDetail: It is shown beside the report. You are told when it is decided.
driver.loads.checkName: The code was emailed to them: I checked this is {name}
driver.loads.failNoCode: They do not have the delivery code
driver.loads.failNoCodeHint: The code is sent to them again, and the sender is asked to say it arrived. Wait a moment, then try Deliver again.
driver.own.title: Your vehicle {plate}
driver.own.plateHint: Write it as it is on the vehicle. The plate it had is kept on its record.
driver.own.plateSavedDetail: Print its sticker again: the one on it shows the old plate.
driver.own.removeLede: Sold, scrapped, or added by mistake: take it off your vehicles.
driver.own.removeMeans: No work is offered for it any more and no shift starts on it. What it did stays on its record, and its plate is free for another vehicle.
driver.own.addLede: A vehicle you own and ride yourself, of a kind your licence covers. It is on your list at once.
driver.own.addedDetail: Tap it under “Which vehicle today?” to start a shift on it.
driver.own.none: No vehicle of yours is on your list. Add the one you ride.
